summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, providing notice of the availability of materials related to its quarterly consolidated results as of June 30, 2026, ahead of an investor conference call scheduled for August 13, 2026. The filing includes links to the quarterly report and presentation for international investors but contains no transactional terms, no board actions, and no special-situation events. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard earnings release announcement. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic activities are indicated; the filing is purely informational and does not qualify as a special situation category.
